subtitle: Interior Design Concept Dashboard
summary: A warm, nostalgic living space shaped around the client's love of green.

texts.heading: Client Inspiration
texts.body: The client was drawn to green for its calming, grounding quality and connection to nature. Olive and sage tones became the visual thread, bringing a sense of comfort and quiet character into the home.

texts.heading: Design Story
texts.body: A warm, nostalgic living space where classic detailing meets everyday comfort. Cream walls soften the palette, while cognac leather, walnut finishes and antique brass add depth and timelessness.

texts.heading: Design Intent
texts.body: A welcoming Sharjah home shaped around the client's love of green, layered textures and a refined vintage mood.
